4a.case: 4a FT-1 box lid on its gasket: clamp preload, +10 mbar purge, +50 mbar fault
4a.supports: gasket bottom (box rim) fixed in z; each clamp pulls the skirt's bottom edge down by the squeeze over 24 mm; hinge = back face nodes within 1 mm of the pin height, x-y-z fixed (pin line), pulled down by the squeeze

fkm.gasket: solid FKM cord Ø3 mm, 75A, 22 % squeeze (0.66 mm)

sponge.gasket: closed-cell silicone sponge 3 x 7.9 mm, ASTM D1056 2A2 (7 psi at 25 %), 25 % squeeze (0.75 mm)
